p1: King Hezekiah sent letters through all the land. He invited everyone to the Lord’s house for the Passover.
The Passover was a special meal remembering when the Lord set His people free. Prophets teach that its little lamb was a picture of Jesus.
The letters said, “Come back to the Lord. He is kind and loves to forgive. He will not turn away from you.”
p2: Many came, but some were not made ready the right way. Hezekiah prayed, “Good Lord, forgive everyone whose heart wants to find You.” The Lord heard him and healed the people. There was great joy!
Jesus invites you too, every day. Tonight, think of someone you can invite to play. Everyone is welcome with Him.
old: Good King Hezekiah wanted everyone to come back to Heavenly Father. He sent invitations all across the land. “Come to God’s house! Let’s celebrate and remember the Lord together!”
Some people laughed and didn’t want to come. That made Hezekiah a little sad. But many other people humbled their hearts and said, “Yes! We will come!” They traveled to join the celebration.

Everyone gathered together to worship and remember Heavenly Father. There was so much joy and singing and gladness! It was the happiest celebration in a very long time. The people’s hearts turned back to God.

Heavenly Father always invites us to come back to Him. There is great joy in worshiping God together. When we come to Him with a humble heart, He welcomes us with love. Coming back to God always brings happiness.
